context.content: Hi Netherlands, Me and my girlfriend and exited to visit the county next week and spend some time sightseeing and exploring the culture. However we encountered a few blog posts about the Maestro dominance in the country and the mastercard and visa being declined in most smaller places within the country. None of us has Maestro card on hand, but I have VPay one issued from my local bank. I read that the VPay is one of the more widely supported than vannila Visa and mastercard, but can't really find information on how widely that is. Thank in advance and looking forward for our visit!
